newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines two-year bonds down to 13.69 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippines two-year bonds down to 13.69 pct.

text.p: The average yield of the Philippines' two-year fixed-rate treasury bonds dropped to 13.69 percent at an auction on Tuesday from the previous 14 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said.
The Bureau said in a statement it had received 7.075 billion pesos worth of tenders for its four-billion peso offering of the two-year notes.
Bid rates reached a high of 13.875 percent and a low of 13.375.
